protocol: PLAN.md 2.4-2.6; frozen matcher research/broad_baseline/score.py score_case; accept threshold 1.5 mm / 2 deg
inputs_seen: raw scan (adjudicator per-station skin checks, gap maps, sections, slope fits)
FRESH label as third marking (TEST-B only, only after the A/B adjudication)
not_seen: no engine, lane, A0, pool, E3, best_f1, CAD or baseline output

lines.reason: Both blind markers merged each side wall into 1 line (A: "short bridges between windows"; B: "5 coplanar segments split by reliefs"). The FRESH third marking has 5 lines per side. Adjudicator gap map on the raw mesh (B line frame, 0.5 mm stations, wall-height bands 1-4, 4-7, 7-10, 10-14 mm): each wall is cut through its full height by ~1-2 mm slits at t ~ -48, -22, 45, 72 on both sides, so each wall is 5 separate tabs (~84/24/65/25/63 mm) joined only to the web; the tab planes also differ by up to ~1.2 deg. Disconnected collinear tabs are separate plates, so 1 line each (GOLD_SET_V2 canary-confirmed ruling in T1, and the same ruling on the twin scan of this part family in T5 gb_0f8d41). Markers wrong, FRESH right. Lines rebuilt by the adjudicator (web side = local web-half plane, tab patch, extent between slits, station_median apex).
